#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def find_report(root: Path) -> Path:
    for p in sorted(root.rglob("report.pdf")):
        if p.is_file():
            return p
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"report.pdf not found under {root}")


def build_cover_pdf(path: Path, width: float, height: float, date_str: str) -> None:
    c = canvas.Canvas(str(path), pagesize=(width, height))
    # Subtle horizontal rule
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.35, 0.45, 0.65)
    c.setLineWidth(2)
    # Title, centered around 60% height of the page
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.08, 0.12, 0.2)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.60, TITLE)
    c.line(width * 0.22, height * 0.585, width * 0.78, height * 0.585)
    # Current date below the title
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.25, 0.28, 0.35)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.54, date_str)
    c.showPage()
    c.save()


def main() -> int:
    root = Path.cwd()
    report_path = find_report(root)
    print(f"[info] Found report: {report_path}")

    reader = PdfReader(str(report_path))
    n_pages = len(reader.pages)
    print(f"[info] Original page count: {n_pages}")

    if n_pages == 0:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages to merge with.")
        return 1

    # Match cover page size to the report's first page
    mb = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mb.width)
    height = float(mb.height)
    print(f"[info] First page size: {width:.1f} x {height:.1f} pt")

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"[info] Using current date: {date_str}")

    # 1) Create the cover page PDF
    cover_path = root / "cover_page_tmp.pdf"
    build_cover_pdf(cover_path, width, height, date_str)
    print(f"[info] Cover page written to {cover_path}")

    # 2) Merge: cover page first, then all original pages
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(str(cover_path))
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    tmp_out = root / "report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
    with open(tmp_out, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    print(f"[info] Merged document written to {tmp_out}")

    # 3) Replace report.pdf with the merged document (cover + original)
    shutil.move(str(tmp_out), str(report_path))
    print(f"[info] report.pdf updated in place")

    # 4) Validate the result
    check = PdfReader(str(report_path))
    print(f"[info] New page count: {len(check.pages)} (expected {n_pages + 1})")
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    print("[info] First page text:")
    for line in first_text.splitlines():
        print("   ", line)
    ok_title = TITLE.lower() in first_text.lower()
    ok_date = date_str in first_text
    print(f"[check] Cover title present: {ok_title}")
    print(f"[check] Cover date present: {ok_date}")
    if not (ok_title and ok_date):
        print("WARNING: cover text not detected on first page.")
        return 2
    print("[ok] Cover page added successfully.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Only transforms report.pdf (in place, after reading the original fully into
memory so it is never opened for writing until the new document is composed),
then validates the result programmatically (page count and first-page text).
"""
import datetime
import io
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle, getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph, SimpleDocTemplate, Spacer

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

report_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"

today = datetime.date.today()
date_text = f"{today.strftime('%B')} {today.day}, {today.year}"


def first_page_text(path):
    """Extract page-1 text with pypdf, falling back to pdfplumber."""
    try:
        text = PdfReader(path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        if text.strip():
            return text
    except Exception:
        pass
    import pdfplumber

    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
        return pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or ""


# 1. Build the cover page in memory.
cover_buf = io.BytesIO()
doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
    cover_buf,
    pagesize=letter,
    leftMargin=1.25 * inch,
    rightMargin=1.25 * inch,
    topMargin=3 * inch,
    bottomMargin=1.5 * inch,
)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
title_style = ParagraphStyle(
    "CoverTitle",
    parent=styles["Title"],
    fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
    fontSize=30,
    leading=36,
    alignment=TA_CENTER,
    spaceAfter=0.5 * inch,
)
date_style = ParagraphStyle(
    "CoverDate",
    parent=styles["Normal"],
    fontName="Helvetica",
    fontSize=16,
    leading=20,
    alignment=TA_CENTER,
)
story = [
    Paragraph(TITLE, title_style),
    Spacer(1, 0.4 * inch),
    Paragraph(date_text, date_style),
]
doc.build(story)
cover_buf.seek(0)

# 2. Read the existing report fully into memory before any write.
with open(report_path, "rb") as fh:
    original_bytes = fh.read()
original_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(original_bytes))
original_page_count = len(original_reader.pages)

# 3. Compose cover + original pages and write back to report.pdf.
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_buf)
writer = PdfWriter()
for page in cover_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
for page in original_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(report_path, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

# 4. Validate the in-place result.
check_reader = PdfReader(report_path)
final_page_count = len(check_reader.pages)
first_text = first_page_text(report_path)
title_present = TITLE in first_text
date_present = date_text in first_text
ok = final_page_count == original_page_count + 1 and title_present and date_present

print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
print(f"Cover date:  {date_text}")
print(f"Original page count: {original_page_count}")
print(f"Final page count:    {final_page_count}")
print(f"Title found on page 1: {title_present}")
print(f"Date found on page 1:  {date_present}")
if not ok:
    print("VALIDATION FAILURE: report.pdf was not updated as requested")
    sys.exit(1)
print("SUCCESS: report.pdf now begins with the requested cover page")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Only transforms report.pdf (in place, after reading the original fully into
memory), then validates the result programmatically. The cover page is built
without reportlab: a single US-Letter page whose content stream draws the
exact title "Annual Financial Report" and today's date with the standard
Helvetica font, centered using AFM Helvetica glyph widths.
"""
import datetime
import io
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

report_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"

today = datetime.date.today()
date_text = f"{today.strftime('%B')} {today.day}, {today.year}"

HELVETICA_WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015,
    "A": 667, "B": 667, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 667, "G": 722,
    "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722,
    "O": 722, "P": 667, "Q": 722, "R": 667, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722,
    "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611,
    "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556, "f": 278, "g": 556,
    "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222, "m": 833, "n": 556,
    "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500, "t": 278, "u": 556,
    "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
}


def text_width_pt(text, font_size):
    total_units = sum(HELVETICA_WIDTHS.get(ch, 556) for ch in text)
    return total_units / 1000.0 * font_size


def build_cover_pdf_bytes(page_w=612.0, page_h=792.0):
    """Return a self-contained single-page PDF with title + date as text."""
    title_size, date_size = 30.0, 16.0
    title_y, date_y = 500.0, 440.0
    title_x = (page_w - text_width_pt(TITLE, title_size)) / 2.0
    date_x = (page_w - text_width_pt(date_text, date_size)) / 2.0

    def draw(text, x, y, size):
        return (
            f"BT /F1 {size:g} Tf 1 0 0 1 {x:.2f} {y:.2f} Tm "
            f"({text}) Tj ET"
        )

    content = (draw(TITLE, title_x, title_y, title_size) + "\n" +
               draw(date_text, date_x, date_y, date_size) + "\n").encode("ascii")

    pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []

    def add_obj(number, body_bytes):
        offsets.append(len(pdf))
        pdf.extend(f"{number} 0 obj\n".encode("ascii"))
        pdf.extend(body_bytes)
        pdf.extend(b"\nendobj\n")

    add_obj(1, b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    add_obj(2, b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>")
    add_obj(3, (
        f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {page_w:g} {page_h:g}] "
        b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
    ))
    add_obj(4, b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    add_obj(5, (
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(content)).encode("ascii") + b" >>\n"
        b"stream\n" + content + b"\nendstream"
    ))

    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf.extend(b"xref\n0 6\n")
    pdf.extend(b"0000000000 65535 f \n")
    for offset in offsets:
        pdf.extend(f"{offset:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("ascii"))
    pdf.extend(
        f"trailer\n<< /Size 6 /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF"
        .encode("ascii")
    )
    return bytes(pdf)


def first_page_text(path):
    """Extract page-1 text with pypdf (pdfplumber fallback if available)."""
    try:
        text = PdfReader(path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        if text.strip():
            return text
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        import pdfplumber

        with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
            return pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    except Exception:
        return ""


# 1. Read the existing report fully into memory before any write.
with open(report_path, "rb") as fh:
    original_bytes = fh.read()
original_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(original_bytes))
original_page_count = len(original_reader.pages)
orig_first_text = (original_reader.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()

# 2. Compose cover page + original pages, then write back to report.pdf.
cover_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(build_cover_pdf_bytes()))
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
for page in original_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(report_path, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

# 3. Validate the in-place result.
check_reader = PdfReader(report_path)
final_page_count = len(check_reader.pages)
first_text = first_page_text(report_path).replace("\n", " ")
title_present = TITLE in first_text
date_present = date_text in first_text
ok = final_page_count == original_page_count + 1 and title_present and date_present

page2_text = (check_reader.pages[1].extract_text() or "").strip()
import re

def norm(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s)

preserved = bool(orig_first_text) and norm(page2_text).startswith(norm(orig_first_text)[:60])

print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
print(f"Cover date:  {date_text}")
print(f"Original page count: {original_page_count}")
print(f"Final page count:    {final_page_count}")
print(f"Title found on page 1: {title_present}")
print(f"Date found on page 1:  {date_present}")
print(f"Original first page preserved on page 2: {preserved}")
if not ok:
    print("VALIDATION FAILURE: report.pdf was not updated as requested")
    sys.exit(1)
print("SUCCESS: report.pdf now begins with the requested cover page")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page ('Annual Financial Report' + current date) to report.pdf."""
import datetime
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"


def find_report(root: Path) -> Path:
    for p in sorted(root.rglob("report.pdf")):
        if p.is_file():
            return p
    raise FileNotFoundError(f"report.pdf not found under {root}")


def build_cover_pdf(path: Path, width: float, height: float, date_str: str) -> None:
    c = canvas.Canvas(str(path), pagesize=(width, height))
    # Subtle horizontal rule
    c.setStrokeColorRGB(0.35, 0.45, 0.65)
    c.setLineWidth(2)
    # Title, centered around 60% height of the page
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.08, 0.12, 0.2)
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 30)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.60, TITLE)
    c.line(width * 0.22, height * 0.585, width * 0.78, height * 0.585)
    # Current date below the title
    c.setFillColorRGB(0.25, 0.28, 0.35)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.54, date_str)
    c.showPage()
    c.save()


def main() -> int:
    root = Path.cwd()
    report_path = find_report(root)
    print(f"[info] Found report: {report_path}")

    reader = PdfReader(str(report_path))
    n_pages = len(reader.pages)
    print(f"[info] Original page count: {n_pages}")

    if n_pages == 0:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages to merge with.")
        return 1

    # Match cover page size to the report's first page
    mb = reader.pages[0].mediabox
    width = float(mb.width)
    height = float(mb.height)
    print(f"[info] First page size: {width:.1f} x {height:.1f} pt")

    date_str = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"[info] Using current date: {date_str}")

    # 1) Create the cover page PDF
    cover_path = root / "cover_page_tmp.pdf"
    build_cover_pdf(cover_path, width, height, date_str)
    print(f"[info] Cover page written to {cover_path}")

    # 2) Merge: cover page first, then all original pages
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(str(cover_path))
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)

    tmp_out = root / "report_with_cover_tmp.pdf"
    with open(tmp_out, "wb") as fh:
        writer.write(fh)
    print(f"[info] Merged document written to {tmp_out}")

    # 3) Replace report.pdf with the merged document (cover + original)
    shutil.move(str(tmp_out), str(report_path))
    print(f"[info] report.pdf updated in place")

    # 4) Validate the result
    check = PdfReader(str(report_path))
    print(f"[info] New page count: {len(check.pages)} (expected {n_pages + 1})")
    first_text = (check.pages[0].extract_text() or "").strip()
    print("[info] First page text:")
    for line in first_text.splitlines():
        print("   ", line)
    ok_title = TITLE.lower() in first_text.lower()
    ok_date = date_str in first_text
    print(f"[check] Cover title present: {ok_title}")
    print(f"[check] Cover date present: {ok_date}")
    if not (ok_title and ok_date):
        print("WARNING: cover text not detected on first page.")
        return 2
    print("[ok] Cover page added successfully.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Task-local helper: prepend a cover page (title + current date) to report.pdf.

Only transforms report.pdf (in place, after reading the original fully into
memory so it is never opened for writing until the new document is composed),
then validates the result programmatically (page count and first-page text).
"""
import datetime
import io
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle, getSampleStyleSheet
from reportlab.lib.units import inch
from reportlab.platypus import Paragraph, SimpleDocTemplate, Spacer

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"

report_path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "report.pdf"

today = datetime.date.today()
date_text = f"{today.strftime('%B')} {today.day}, {today.year}"


def first_page_text(path):
    """Extract page-1 text with pypdf, falling back to pdfplumber."""
    try:
        text = PdfReader(path).pages[0].extract_text() or ""
        if text.strip():
            return text
    except Exception:
        pass
    import pdfplumber

    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
        return pdf.pages[0].extract_text() or ""


# 1. Build the cover page in memory.
cover_buf = io.BytesIO()
doc = SimpleDocTemplate(
    cover_buf,
    pagesize=letter,
    leftMargin=1.25 * inch,
    rightMargin=1.25 * inch,
    topMargin=3 * inch,
    bottomMargin=1.5 * inch,
)
styles = getSampleStyleSheet()
title_style = ParagraphStyle(
    "CoverTitle",
    parent=styles["Title"],
    fontName="Helvetica-Bold",
    fontSize=30,
    leading=36,
    alignment=TA_CENTER,
    spaceAfter=0.5 * inch,
)
date_style = ParagraphStyle(
    "CoverDate",
    parent=styles["Normal"],
    fontName="Helvetica",
    fontSize=16,
    leading=20,
    alignment=TA_CENTER,
)
story = [
    Paragraph(TITLE, title_style),
    Spacer(1, 0.4 * inch),
    Paragraph(date_text, date_style),
]
doc.build(story)
cover_buf.seek(0)

# 2. Read the existing report fully into memory before any write.
with open(report_path, "rb") as fh:
    original_bytes = fh.read()
original_reader = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(original_bytes))
original_page_count = len(original_reader.pages)

# 3. Compose cover + original pages and write back to report.pdf.
cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_buf)
writer = PdfWriter()
for page in cover_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
for page in original_reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(report_path, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

# 4. Validate the in-place result.
check_reader = PdfReader(report_path)
final_page_count = len(check_reader.pages)
first_text = first_page_text(report_path)
title_present = TITLE in first_text
date_present = date_text in first_text
ok = final_page_count == original_page_count + 1 and title_present and date_present

print(f"Cover title: {TITLE}")
print(f"Cover date:  {date_text}")
print(f"Original page count: {original_page_count}")
print(f"Final page count:    {final_page_count}")
print(f"Title found on page 1: {title_present}")
print(f"Date found on page 1:  {date_present}")
if not ok:
    print("VALIDATION FAILURE: report.pdf was not updated as requested")
    sys.exit(1)
print("SUCCESS: report.pdf now begins with the requested cover page")
